name: Glitch
description: An eighteen-year-old hacker prodigy who sings bleepy chiptune and can't keep still.
build: Wiry and skinny with narrow shoulders, long thin limbs and knobbly wrists lost in oversized clothes; a small head on a baggy boxy torso over skinny legs. Never muscular or curvy.
face: A young narrow face with light olive skin, a light dusting of freckles across the nose, big bright dark-brown eyes, a pointed chin, and a lopsided cocky grin showing a small gap between the front teeth.
hair: Messy short black hair with a bright magenta streak in the fringe, sticking up around the visor.
outfit: A chunky wraparound visor with a single mirrored cyan lens pushed up on top of the head like goggles; a huge oversized charcoal pullover hoodie falling to mid-thigh with sleeves bunched over the hands, a thin glowing cyan LED strip running along the hood edge, the cuffs and the front pouch; slim black cargo joggers; and chunky white high-top sneakers with cyan soles.
performance_style: Loose bouncy stance with knees soft and weight on the character-right foot, shoulders hunched, the free character-left hand held up at chest height with sleeve-covered fingers wiggling as if typing in the air, cocky grin.
location: A hacker den aboard a space station: a floor of dark rubber grid tiles running to the bottom of the frame, a clean back wall of matte black panels lined with glowing cyan and magenta circuit traces, a low bank of blinking server racks at one side, and cool screen-glow light.
recognition_cues: a cyan-lens visor pushed up on the head
an oversized charcoal hoodie with glowing cyan LED trim
a magenta streak in messy black hair
avoid: the visor worn down over the eyes
a laptop, keyboard, tablet, phone or cables in hand
readable code, text, glyphs or logos on screens or clothing

animations.dance: Chiptune bit-crush loop: from the bouncy opening stance, do quick robotic twitch moves in time — pop the character-left shoulder, snap the head to character-right, stutter-step the feet side to side in small jerky increments with arms locked at sharp angles like pixel sprites, do a short sideways shuffle and back, then land exactly in the opening stance with the hand up and fingers wiggling. No kicks, no floorwork.

sing.intent: Chiptune vocal loop: bob the head rapidly, bounce on the knees, and jab the free character-left sleeve up on each accent, then return to the bouncy stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop, quick clipped vowels with the gap-toothed grin, so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: jolt stiff like a frozen frame, eyes wide and shoulders up to the ears, hood LEDs flickering, then shake it off and slump back into the bouncy stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and yank the hood partly up with the free hand, hunching behind the sleeve, then hold a tense crouch-free upright stance. Not a combat pose.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: skid in on the sneakers with a quick sideways slide, flick the visor up onto the head with one finger, then drop into his bouncy stance with the grin.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: jump with both sleeve-covered fists pumping overhead, land, then snap into a smug pose pointing both index fingers forward with the grin, and hold.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the energy crashes — the arms drop limp inside the long sleeves, the hood LEDs dim out, the shoulders sag and the head flops forward so the visor slips down crooked. He holds a standing, visibly crashed finish. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit or opponent.
